Editor.Title: Paperdoll Layout (all characters)
Editor.Label: Label on the sheet
Editor.NoSelection: Click a slot to edit it, or a + to add a new one.
Editor.Hint: Click anywhere on the figure to add a slot there (or use a +). Drag slots to move them. Any type may be used several times. Wondrous items are recognized by name; if that fails, hold Shift while dropping it on the slot. Hands and armor class can be moved too.
Editor.IconReset: Default icon of the slot type

Editor.Name: Paperdoll layout
Editor.Label: Edit slots
Editor.Hint: Add, remove and type the equipment slots of the paperdoll for all characters.

Enabled.Name: Replace inventory tab
Enabled.Hint: Show the paperdoll inventory on character sheets.

HideSidebar.Name: Hide sidebar on the inventory tab
HideSidebar.Hint: The portrait moves into the paperdoll; other tabs keep the sidebar.

PlayersEquip.Name: Players may equip
PlayersEquip.Hint: If disabled, only the GM can change the paperdoll.

Strict.Name: Strict slot types
Strict.Hint: Only allow items that match the slot type.

HideWorn.Name: Hide equipped items from the list
HideWorn.Hint: Equipped items, weapon sets and attached containers only appear on the paperdoll, not in the item list.

Ground.Name: Allow dropping on the ground
Ground.Hint: Needs Ascandir - DnD5e Lootplacement or Item Piles.

AutoEquip.Name: Auto-place equipped items
AutoEquip.Hint: Equipping an item in the list (shield icon) moves it onto the matching paperdoll slot or into the active weapon set.

Purse.Name: Use purses
Purse.Hint: Coins are kept in purse containers with a limited capacity. The normal currency of the sheet is hidden. Turning it off brings the normal currency back.

PurseCap.Name: Purse capacity (coins)
PurseCap.Hint: How many coins a purse holds by default. The GM can change it per purse on the sheet.

Attune.Name: Attune on equip
Attune.Hint: Equipping an item that requires attunement attunes it if a slot is free; removing it from the paperdoll ends the attunement. Switching weapon sets does not change attunement.

Purse.Title: Purse
Purse.None: No purse – this character cannot carry coins.
Purse.Loose: No room in the purse, loose coins
Purse.Overflow: {n} coins did not fit into the purse and are carried loose.
Purse.MigrateIn: Purses are now active. Move every character's coins into a purse? Characters without a purse get one.
Purse.MigrateOut: Purses are now off. Move all coins from purses back into the characters' normal currency?
